title: 凯尔·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 浅色头发与金色冠饰头盔相映，浅金羽翼呈现层叠羽毛。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kayle is an adult winged armored woman with long pale hair, a gold crested helmet, luminous eyes, and layered pale golden feathered wings. Preserve her radiant knight silhouette and natural adult proportions with fully covering gold-white armor, opaque underlayers, gauntlets, and boots. Her paired swords remain sheathed, and the wings are partly folded in a ceremonial still pose rather than a battle spread.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: pale gold, feather ivory, cobalt shadow, warm silver; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
